world.title: A fraction of an antidepressant dose may help people with chronic insomnia sleep better
world.description: A retrospective case series of 40 adults with chronic insomnia found that very low-dose mirtazapine, alone or combined with low-dose gabapentin, was associated with sustained improvements in self-reported sleep, with more than three-quarters of patients taking benzodiazepines or Z-drugs discontinuing these medications. The findings support further controlled trials to establish the efficacy, safety, and optimal dosing of this off-label treatment approach.
